name: Fundy National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed at picnic areas, campgrounds and along the many trails.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed at picnic areas, campgrounds and along the many trails.

excerpts.quote: You can have your dog with you at picnic areas and camping areas, and along the many trails in the Park.

dogRules.text: Pets must be leashed and never left unattended.
No pets in campground kitchen shelters or washrooms, at Bennett Lake beach, the swimming pool or the golf course.
Some areas are closed to pets; check notices at trailheads.
